info.title: Paysafe Customer Vault API
info.description: Securely store customer profiles, cards, bank accounts and addresses so that repeat and recurring payments never touch raw instrument data in your systems.

tags.name: Single-use tokens
tags.description: Exchange a single-use token for a permanent vault token.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of profiles, most recent first.
Retrieves a single profile by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing profile.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of addresses, most recent first.
Retrieves a single address by its Paysafe id.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing address.

get.description: Returns a paginated list of stored cards, most recent first.
Retrieves a single stored card by its Paysafe id.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the stored card.

put.description: Updates a mutable field on an existing stored card.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the stored card.

post.description: Runs a zero-dollar verification against the stored card.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the stored card.
